evidence.reason: The finding alleges the warning loop in src/cli/main.ts writes CQ_* env warnings to stderr unconditionally, breaking the I1/README empty-stderr machine-mode contract. At the pinned tip (e9ddcdab), content_search shows line 542 is now `if (rawMode !== 'json') for (const line of check.warningLines) io.stderr(`${line}\n`);`, i.e. the loop is gated on mode exactly as the proposed fix requested. The history's first entry, commit 0447b38ed9ad9ad89637d7ed1fbceec09b87279e ("suppress CQ warning lines in json mode"), is the change that added this guard. The original_region text (unguarded loop) no longer matches current code, so the defect is already resolved at the tip.
